_note: These two are cited by number/series/subject inside the Municipal Government of Aborlan Citizen's Charter 2025 (1st revision) — a primary LGU document — but the Charter doesn't include their full text. Treat as confirmed-to-exist, not as a complete ordinance registry; the rest of the Sangguniang Bayan's ordinance log still needs to come from the SB Secretary, an FOI request, or the LGU directly.

ordinances.title: Municipal Tax Ordinance No. 01, Series of 2018
ordinances.description: Revenue Code — governs business permit fees, taxes, and charges (basis for BPLO's business tax computation).

ordinances.title: Municipal Ordinance No. 17, Series of 2009
ordinances.description: Mandates barangays and institutions within Aborlan's jurisdiction to participate in the municipality's solid waste/garbage collection system.
